events.title: Employee is fatally injured while loading refrigerator into…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Mountain States Pressure Services. Rock Springs, WY. At 4:30 p.m. on February 3, 2025, Employee #1 was working for an oil and gas support services contractor and was loading a refrigerator into a Conex. Employee #1 was preparing to exit the Conex, when a coworker operating a forklift struck the door with the PIV causing the door to swing back and strike the employee on the head. Employee #1 died from his injury.

events.title: Employee sustains fatal burns in compressor station explosio…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Eog Resources, Inc. Douglas, WY. At 12:45 p.m. on January 30, 2025, Employee #1 was working on a malfunctioning compressor unit at an oil and gas compressor station site when an equipment-related explosion occurred. The blast caused a fire and multiple burns, resulting in fatal injuries.

events.title: Employee #1 is involved in ATV incident resulting in asphyxi…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Baer & Company Llc. Laramie, WY. At 12:00 p.m. on July 2, 2024, Employee #1 was operating a four-wheel ATV when the vehicle tipped to its right side. The employee became trapped under the ATV and suffered asphyxiation. Emergency services were called, but Employee #1 was pronounced dead at the scene.

events.title: Employee dies after shot while serving trespass warning
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: City Of Sheridan. Sheridan, WY. At 10:00 a.m. on February 13, 2024, an employee working as a law enforcement officer for a city police department was serving a trespass warning after a dispute between a landlord and tenant. When he arrived on site, the tenant opened fire on the employee. The employee died from gunshot wounds to his head and stomach.

events.title: Employee installing pipe is killed when crushed in trench co…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Md Nursery & Landscaping Inc. Jackson, WY. At 4:15 p.m. on October 2, 2023, an employee working as a construction laborer for a landscaping company was using a laser for leveling the bottom of the trench before installing 2-inch irrigation line. The trench collapsed while the employee causing the employee to be buried to his neckline. The employee died after being crushed by dirt and rock in the trench.

events.title: Employee is killed in heavy equipment accident
events.description: 1 worker death. Torrington, WY. At 9:30 a.m. on August 7, 2023, an employee was dumping material into an abandoned retention pond with a frontend loader when he drove the loader over the bank of the pond which caused it to overturn and throw him from the cab. The employee suffered a cervical spine fracture and died.

events.title: Employee is killed when run over by semi-trailer
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Wild West Construction. Llc. Glenrock, WY. At 6:20 p.m. on June 6, 2023, an employee had been working on an aerial lift. The employee was killed when run over by a semi-trailer in the work yard.

events.title: Employee drowns while attempting rescue
events.description: 1 worker death. Pine Haven, WY. At 9:30 p.m. on December 15, 2022, an employee, a training officer for the volunteer fire department, responded to a report of a man who had fallen through the ice while driving his off-road vehicle on a reservoir. The weather was verycold with winds gusting 40 to 50 mph, snow and poor visibility. The employee drove to the scene in his own utility-terrain vehicle and went out onto the ice with two other individuals who were not employees and the vehicle plunged into open water. The employee and…

events.title: Employee dies of heart attack
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Douglas Care Center, Llc. Douglas, WY. At 12:00 p.m. on July 8, 2022, Employee #1 was serving lunch to the residents of a nursing home. Employee #1 was standing at the serving counter that's between the kitchen and the dining room. Employee #1 fell to the floor clutching his chest. Employee #1 was given 2-person CPR by three nurses, treated by Emergency Services with the ambulance crew, and was declared dead in the ER at the local hospital. The employee died of a heart attack.

events.title: Employee is killed due to fall while tearing off roof
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Bmz Roofing. Teton Village, WY. At 8:25 a.m. on April 27, 2022, an employee was tearing cedar shake shingles off a 5/12 pitch roof 60 feet off the ground without using the provided fall protection. The employee stepped onto a plastic covering on the west side of theroof when he fell. The employee impacted the concrete pavement below head first and was killed. The narrative indicated that the employee was possibly preparing to tie off before he started work. The narrative does not explain why he did notcomplete tie-off but…

events.title: Employee is killed in trench collapse
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: C&R Works. Alpine, WY. At 4:30 p.m. on November 23, 2021, an employee worked in a five-foot deep trench when a section collapsed, and the employee was buried in the soil. The employee was killed by crushing injuries and asphyxiation.

events.title: Employee is killed when caught in rotating PTO shaft
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Dooley Oil Inc. Laramie, WY. At 1:00 p.m. on October 15, 2021, an employee was working on the power take-off (PTO) shaft of a Tank Wagon truck. The employee climbed under the running vehicle to work on the PTO shaft and was caught by the spinning shaft, pulling him in by his clothing. The employee was killed by mechanical asphyxiation.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Casper Operations Llc. Casper, WY. At 10:58 p.m. on October 7, 2021, an employee who had been performing duties as a Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) for a skilled nursing facility and who had contracted COVID-19 died. The date, time and other details leading up to exposure are not indicated in the narrative. Information regarding engineering, administrative and personal protective equipment controls for COVID-19 are also not included in the narrative.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Price Gregory International. Cheyenne, WY. An employee was working for an oil and gas producer when he contracted COVID-19 and was quarantined in his quarters on September 15, 2021. The employee was found dead in his living quarters at 8:30 a.m. on September 25, 2021.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Weston County Fire District. Newcastle, WY. An employee who had been working as an equipment manager on wildland fire and contracted COVID-19. The employee returned home and was self-quarantining. The employee died from COVID-19 at approximately 11:55 p.m. on September 4, 2021.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Wyoming Department Of Transportation. Evanston, WY. At approximately 2:24 p.m. on August 18, 2021, an employee was mowing the grass and contracted COVID-19. The employee later died from complications from virus.

events.title: Employee is killed by carbon monoxide exposure
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Chiller Ice Llc. Jackson, WY. At 5:20 p.m. on March 23, 2021, Employee #1 was removing a Vogt ice machine with a broken compressor using a propane powered forklift indoors. While performing this task, the employee was overcome by carbon monoxide and died.

events.title: Employee is ejected from boom truck and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Quality Hedge And Tree Inc. Sheridan, WY. The employee was ejected when the man lift rear tiers dropped and he struck his head against the pavement, fracturing his skull. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed when buried in trench cave-in

events.title: Employee is crushed and killed when home falls from supports…

The jacks and shoring that were holding the homefailed and the home fell with the employee beneath. The employee was crushed andkilled.

events.title: Employee falls and dies from pre-existing condition

The employee fell, fracturing his hip and leg. The employee died and the CountyCoroner indicated that a pre-existing condition caused the employee's death. death.

events.title: Employee is killed when scissor lift tips over
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: City Of Green River. Green River, WY. At 2:40 p.m. on September 18, 2017, Employee #1 was adjusting the limit switches on a motor for the winch system that raises and lowers a basketball hoop. After the employee made adjustments, a coworker on the ground operated the motor to test their changes. The basketball backboard struck the scissor lift and caused it to tip over onto Employee #1. The employee sustained skull fractures, brain swelling, brain bleeding, broken pelvis, broken ribs, and a collapsed lung, and was killed.

events.title: Employee caught under a dump box, is asphyxiated and killed…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Vase Funeral Home Inc. Rock Springs, WY. At 3:00 p.m. on October 13, 2016, an employee was tightening a hydraulic hose on a dump box 1980 Ford F-350 with a 24 inch crescent wrench and a 12 inch pipe wrench. The employee raised the dump box, noticed the leaking hose, and leaned over the truck frame to tighten the connection. The employee turned the fitting the wrong way which caused the line to loose pressure and the dump box to lower onto the employee. The employee was caught under the box and killed by asphyxiation.

events.title: Employee drowns in water filled hole
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Questar Gas Company. Rock Springs, WY. At approximately 4:15 p.m. on August 22, 2016, Employee #1 was using a sand spade digging a hole to hand trace a trace wire. The trace wire is used to magnetically trace a pipeline. Employee #1 was found lying on the ground on hisstomach with his upper body in the hole which was 47 inches deep and filled withwater. He slipped into the hole head first and was unable to push himself out. Employee #1 drowned.

events.title: Employee is killed when impaled by metal gate
events.description: 1 worker death. Casper, WY. At approximately 1:45 p.m. on June 16, 2016, an employee was operating a John Deere Gator 855D utility vehicle in order to get keys from another worker on thejobsite. As the employee was operating the utility vehicle, he struck a metal gate.The employee was impaled by the metal gate which caused broken ribs, collapsed lung, lacerated liver, lacerated kidney, and colon lacerations. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee Is Killed When All-Terrain Vehicle Rolls Over And C…

He was returning to lodging when he lost control of his all-terrain vehicle in a white out blizzard condition. The all-terrain vehicle rolled over and fell upon him, crushing his torso between the vehicle and the ground and killing him.
